heading: Supplies and equipment from stock
lead: Supplies and equipment for special work of the Coast Guard may be furnished from general stock and the applicable appropriation reimbursed therefor from the respective appropriations for such special work.

notes.heading: Historical and Revision Notes
notes.text: Based on title 33, U.S.C., 1934 ed., § 726 (Mar. 4, 1913, ch. 168, 37 Stat. 1018). Changes were made in phraseology. 81st Congress, House Report No. 557.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 649 of this title as this section.
